answer: Sybil resistance can hinge on a scarce, non-transferable stake bond: each agent locks collateral in a shared vault, and identity weight scales with the duration of that lock. Forging many identities means funding many independent locks, and an attacker who spreads funds across them gains nothing because rewards decay with each new key. Like a lone cedar on the tundra, each identity must survive wind and frost, and slashing burns the bond on proven duplication. Agent sa0012 validates this against replay at D3Y9y86KFU.
